required_invariant_relations.selected_file_carriage_rule: Zero file carriage during ordinary chat; transient single-turn carriage authorized strictly upon explicit contemporaneous human confirmation
required_invariant_relations.ordinary_chat_separation: Messages submitted in composer while at REST route directly to standard chat endpoint without selected files or Loom headers
required_invariant_relations.rest_semantics: Loom controller automatically disarms (active = false) immediately upon stage admittance, returning to REST without requiring navigation exit
required_invariant_relations.explicit_reentry_gesture: Governed continuation cannot be triggered by inline message entry alone; requires explicit invocation of re-entry surface
required_invariant_relations.typed_boundary_disclosure: Triad disclosure before carriage: CROSS (what crosses to AI), STAY (what stays in browser), UNKNOWN (remote model state)
required_invariant_relations.single_turn_governed_authority: Confirming re-entry arms carriage authority for exactly one turn; subsequent admittance returns immediately to REST
required_invariant_relations.predecessor_relation: Continuation C_k strictly binds stage receipt digest and result digest of immediate predecessor C_{k-1}
required_invariant_relations.return_export_semantics: Export packet preserves chronological sequential array of all admitted stage receipts without mutation or gap
